name: Claude Usage
author: mryll
description: Claude AI plan usage (claudebar) in the Omarchy bar: session, weekly, and per-model limits with pacing.

barWidget.description: Click: usage panel. Middle click: force refresh. Right click: open the claude.ai usage page.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to run claudebar. The API response is cached for 60s; intervals below 300s may hit API rate limits.

schema.label: Show usage % on the bar
schema.description: Show a compact usage percentage next to the icon (horizontal bars only).

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only. Severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs.

schema.label: Bar label window
schema.description: Which usage window drives the percentage shown on the bar.
